races.name: The Border (Hell Race) — 50 km 'The Frontline Dash'
races.event_date_text: 19-20 Dec 2026 (start 12 noon 19 Dec; 50 km cut-off 8 h). Bib expo 17-18 Dec 2026.
races.notes: Identification: 'Border Ultra' = The Hell Race's event 'THE BORDER' (100 mi / 100 km / 50 km, Jaisalmer-Longewala); the only Hell Race border-area event with a 50 km category in 2026 (KonfHub title 'THE BORDER 2026 - JAISALMER TO LAUNGEWALA | 100 MILES | 100 KM | 50 KM'). Status 'closed' = SOLD OUT: on 2026-10-03 the KonfHub JSON shows sold_out:true for 50 KM (and 100 KM, 100 Miles), even though thehellrace.com still shows 'REGISTER NOW'. 50 KM ticket sale start 2026-09-15 12:00 IST; KonfHub end timestamp equals race end (20 Dec), so no separate close date. Previous: 2025 edition (6-7 Dec 2025) 50 km ticket 7 Nov 2025 12:00 IST to 16 Nov 2025 00:00 IST; 2024 edition (14-15 Dec 2024) 1 Jul 2024 to 21 Nov 2024 04:00 IST. KonfHub timestamps are UTC; converted to IST. Ticket start dates may reflect re-opened ticket types, not first opening. Fee 50 km INR 7,450. allinrunning.com/the-border is a third-party training/travel package, not the organiser.

The other Goa ultra is Hell Race 'Goa Ultra' (see hell-race-goa-ultra). Open now: the official site's JS bundle shows 'Register Now' and a 'Festival Offer' countdown to 2026-10-15 23:59 ('Prices increase by Rs300-500 after October 15th'). 2026 close date not on official site (one aggregator summary said 25 Nov; unverified, so null). INFERENCE: likely ~25-30 Nov 2026 based on 2025 (25 Nov) and 2023 (30 Nov). 2025 open date: FAQ says early-bird is 'first two months of registration' but no date. The valmikinayak.in domain appears to be a mirror/archive of the 2025 official site (countdown 'Dec 14, 2025') - treat with medium confidence.
